waypoints.name: Nooksack Cirque Trailhead (Trail #750)
waypoints.note: Same road-end trailhead as the East Ridge route. The first-ascent party camped on the shoulder dividing the Price Glacier from the Nooksack Cirque area, then downclimbed/rappelled to the East Nooksack Glacier to reach the base of the South Face — i.e. the same Nooksack Cirque valley approach, just continuing further around/over to the back (south) side of the peak rather than staying on the ridge.
waypoints.directions: From Glacier, drive the Mount Baker Highway (SR-542) east about 12.5 miles and turn left onto Hannegan Pass Road (FS 32). In just over a mile turn right onto Nooksack Cirque Road (FS 34) and follow it about a mile to the parking area at the road end by Ruth Creek, about 2,150 ft. No parking pass is needed; overnight stays require a North Cascades National Park backcountry permit.

waypoints.name: Nooksack Tower summit
waypoints.directions: Follow the North Face approach: cross Ruth Creek, walk the old roadbed about 2 miles, ford the Nooksack, and climb past Price Lake onto the moraine and rib above it. At the top of the rib, traverse onto the East Nooksack Glacier rather than the Price and climb it to where the south face rises straight out of the ice; the route starts on the face's right side and runs about 12 pitches to the summit.
